final: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.ID, g.cnt, 1.0 * g.cnt / s.total AS share FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM p), q AS (SELECT p.ID, p.cnt, p.share, p.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM p JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL) SELECT ID, cnt, share, diff FROM q WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a) ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
